title: Parking-lot closure
passage:
Why is the north parking lot closed?
A. They're repainting the lines. B. You can park after five. C. It's the closest one to the office.
passageZh:
北側停車場為什麼關閉？
A. 他們正在重新畫停車格線。
B. 五點後可以停車。
C. 它是離辦公室最近的一個。
